tiers.label: Foundations
tiers.description: For the reader starting from scratch: the on-ramp before any real course.

tiers.label: Core
tiers.description: For the new student: the first course in each broad area, taken by everyone.

tiers.label: Advanced core
tiers.description: For the reader with the core done: second courses, the shared toolkit of every mathematician.

tiers.label: Specialization
tiers.description: For the reader committed to an area: the entry books of each research track.

tiers.label: Research preparation
tiers.description: For the specialist preparing for research: books that end where the current literature begins.

nodes.title: Abelian Varieties
nodes.description: Complex tori and their cohomology. Line bundles and the Appell-Humbert theorem. Polarizations, the Siegel upper half-space, and Riemann-Roch. Theta functions and the Lefschetz embedding theorem. Dual tori, isogenies, and Poincaré reducibility. Endomorphism algebras, Albert's classification, and complex multiplication. Abelian varieties over arbitrary fields: the theorem of the cube, Tate modules, the dual abelian variety, and the Weil pairing. Jacobians, the Abel-Jacobi map, and the Torelli theorem. Abelian varieties over finite fields, the Riemann hypothesis, Tate's isogeny theorem, and the Honda-Tate theorem. Chevalley's structure theorem.

nodes.title: Algebraic Geometry
nodes.description: Sheaves, pushforward and pullback, and ringed spaces. Spec, schemes, Proj, dimension, and regular and smooth schemes. Morphisms: fiber products, the functor of points, finiteness conditions, separated and proper morphisms, rational maps, and Bertini's theorems. Group schemes. Quasi-coherent sheaves, divisors and the Picard group, and differentials. Sheaf cohomology, the cohomology of projective space, Serre duality, higher direct images, flatness and semicontinuity, and GAGA. Curves: Riemann-Roch and Hurwitz's formula. Surfaces: intersection theory, the Hodge index theorem, blow-ups, the Enriques-Kodaira classification, and the Weil bound for curves over finite fields.

nodes.title: Algebraic K-Theory
nodes.description: Projective modules and the Picard group. The Grothendieck group K₀ of a ring. K₀ of abelian and exact categories. K₁ and the Whitehead group, and K₂ and the Steinberg group. Higher K-theory by the plus construction and the Q-construction, and their equivalence. G-theory, the fundamental theorems of resolution, dévissage, and localization, and the K-theory of finite fields. K₀ of a scheme. Milnor K-theory and Matsumoto's theorem, the additivity and Bass fundamental theorems, and the higher K-theory of rings of integers coming soon.

nodes.title: Algebraic Number Theory
nodes.description: Number fields, rings of integers, and discriminants. Dedekind domains, unique factorization of ideals, the ideal class group, and Dirichlet's unit theorem. Splitting and ramification of primes, Frobenius automorphisms, cyclotomic fields, and quadratic reciprocity. The Kronecker-Weber theorem. Modules over Dedekind domains and infinite Galois theory.

nodes.title: Algebraic Topology
nodes.description: Homotopy and cell complexes. The fundamental group, van Kampen's theorem, and the classification of covering spaces. Δ-complexes, singular and relative homology. Cohomology, cup and cap products, the Künneth formula, Poincaré duality, and local coefficients. Higher homotopy groups, fibrations, the Whitehead and Hurewicz theorems, Eilenberg-MacLane spaces, classifying spaces, Postnikov towers, and Freudenthal suspension. The Serre spectral sequence. Characteristic classes, the Thom isomorphism, and obstruction theory. Generalized cohomology, Brown representability, spectra, and the Atiyah-Hirzebruch spectral sequence. Steenrod squares.

nodes.title: Analytic Number Theory
nodes.description: Arithmetic functions and summation methods. Dirichlet series and Euler products. Chebyshev's estimates, Mertens' theorems, and Bertrand's postulate. The Riemann zeta function, the prime number theorem, and the zero-free region. The functional equation and the Riemann hypothesis. Dirichlet characters, L-functions, and primes in arithmetic progressions. Dedekind zeta functions and the class number formula. Hecke and Artin L-functions and the Chebotarev density theorem. Character sums and exponential sums. Sieve methods: Brun, Selberg, and the large sieve.

nodes.title: Multivariable Calculus
nodes.description: Differentiation in Rⁿ. The inverse and implicit function theorems. Multiple integrals, Fubini's theorem, and change of variables. Partitions of unity on Rⁿ. Line and surface integrals and the theorems of Green, Stokes, and Gauss in two and three dimensions. All coming soon.

nodes.title: Category Theory
nodes.description: Categories, functors, and natural transformations. Yoneda's lemma and the functor of points. Universal properties, limits and colimits, adjunctions and the general and special adjoint functor theorems. Monads with their Eilenberg-Moore algebras, the Kleisli category, and Beck monadicity. Kan extensions, the pointwise formula, ends, coends, and density. Monoidal categories and Mac Lane's coherence theorem, and enriched and 2-categories.

nodes.title: Class Field Theory
nodes.description: Global class field theory through ideals and the Artin map. Congruence subgroups, conductors, and ray class groups. Artin reciprocity and Diophantine applications. The idelic formulation: local class field theory and adèles. The Kronecker-Weber theorem, Hilbert symbols and explicit reciprocity, the Hasse norm theorem, and the Chebotarev density theorem.

nodes.title: Classical Algebraic Geometry
nodes.description: Algebraic sets, the Zariski topology, and Hilbert's Nullstellensatz. Coordinate rings, rational maps, and birational equivalence. Dimension, smooth points and regular local rings, tangent cones, normalization, and Weil divisors. Projective and quasi-projective varieties, Hilbert functions, completeness, finite maps, and the dimension of fibres. Projective embeddings, Grassmannians, constructible sets, and the lines on a cubic surface. Plane curves: intersection multiplicity, the theorems of Bézout and Max Noether, divisors and genus, the group law on a cubic, the canonical class, resolution by blowing up, and Riemann-Roch.

nodes.title: Commutative Algebra
nodes.description: Noetherian rings, Hilbert's basis theorem, Gröbner bases, and localization. Primary decomposition and associated primes. Completion and the Cohen structure theorem. Integral extensions, going up and going down. Valuation rings and discrete valuation rings. Artinian rings. Dimension theory: Noether normalization, Hilbert-Samuel functions, Krull's principal ideal theorem, and regular local rings. Flatness, faithfully flat descent, and generic flatness.

nodes.title: Complex Analysis
nodes.description: Complex numbers, their geometry, and complex functions. Complex differentiation, power series, and the elementary functions. Complex integration, winding numbers, Cauchy's theorem, singularities, and the residue theorem. Normal families and Montel's theorem, Weierstrass factorization, and Picard's theorems. Elliptic functions and the Weierstrass ℘-function. The Riemann mapping theorem, Riemann surfaces, divisors, and the Riemann-Roch theorem. Harmonic functions and the Dirichlet problem on the disk. Several complex variables and Hartogs's theorems.

nodes.title: Complex Analytic Geometry
nodes.description: Holomorphic functions of several variables and the local ring of convergent power series. Complex manifolds, holomorphic vector bundles, and divisors. Plurisubharmonic functions, pseudoconvexity, Hörmander's L² estimates, and the Newlander-Nirenberg theorem. Coherent analytic sheaves, Stein manifolds and Theorems A and B, the Cousin problems, and the Oka principle. Analytic sets and currents. Positivity, Kodaira vanishing and embedding, and deformations of complex structures. All coming soon.

nodes.title: Core Algebra
nodes.description: Groups: subgroups, quotients, group actions, and Sylow's theorems. Presentations, extensions, direct and semidirect products, finitely generated abelian groups, solvable and nilpotent groups, monoids, and the category of groups. Rings: ideals, localization, PIDs, unique factorization, and polynomial rings. Modules: vector spaces, modules over a PID and the canonical forms, tensor products, multilinear algebra, projective, injective, and flat modules, and Morita theory. Fields: algebraic and separable extensions, finite fields, Galois theory, Kummer theory, ordered fields, and absolute values. Quadratic and alternating forms, Witt's theorems, the Witt group, and Clifford algebras.

nodes.title: Core Probability
nodes.description: Probability spaces, discrete distributions, independence, and expectation. Variance and covariance, the law of large numbers, and random graphs. Concentration inequalities and the Johnson-Lindenstrauss lemma. The Gaussian distribution and the central limit theorem. Markov chains coming soon.

nodes.title: Core Representation Theory
nodes.description: Semisimple rings and modules, the Artin-Wedderburn theorem, and central simple algebras. The Jacobson radical, indecomposable modules, and the Krull-Schmidt theorem. Representations of finite groups: Maschke's theorem, characters and the orthogonality relations, Burnside's theorem, induced representations and Frobenius reciprocity, the Fourier transform on finite abelian groups, and modular representations. Quiver representations, Gabriel's theorem, path algebras, and bound quiver algebras.

nodes.title: C*-Algebras and K-Theory
nodes.description: Banach algebras and C*-algebras. Spectral theory and the continuous functional calculus. Commutative C*-algebras, Gelfand-Naimark duality, and the Serre-Swan theorem. States, the GNS construction, and the Gelfand-Naimark theorem. Representations and multiplier algebras. K₀ and K₁ of a C*-algebra, the six-term exact sequence, Bott periodicity, and the Toeplitz index theorem. AF algebras, KK-theory, and K-homology coming soon.

nodes.title: Differential Topology
nodes.description: Topological and smooth manifolds, smooth maps, and submanifolds. Tangent bundles, the rank theorem, quotient manifolds, and homogeneous spaces. Vector fields, flows, and the Frobenius theorem. Sard's theorem, transversality, and Whitney's embedding theorem. Intersection and degree theory, the Lefschetz fixed-point theorem, and the Poincaré-Hopf theorem. Morse theory and Morse homology. Cobordism and the Pontryagin-Thom construction. Fiber, vector, and principal bundles. Differential forms, integration, and Stokes' theorem. De Rham cohomology, the de Rham theorem, and Poincaré duality.

nodes.title: Elementary Analysis
nodes.description: The real numbers by Cauchy sequences, completeness, and the least upper bound property. Sequences, series, and power series. Limits, continuity, the intermediate and extreme value theorems, and uniform continuity. The derivative, the mean value theorem, Taylor's theorem, uniform convergence, and the elementary functions. The Riemann integral, the fundamental theorem of calculus, and the Riemann-Stieltjes integral. The construction by Dedekind cuts.

nodes.title: Elliptic Curves
nodes.description: Weierstrass equations, the j-invariant, the group law, and twists. Isogenies, torsion, the Tate module, the Weil pairing, and endomorphism rings. The analytic theory: lattices, the ℘-function, uniformization, and the modular group. Formal groups. Curves over finite fields, the Weil conjectures, and supersingular curves. Reduction over local fields. Galois cohomology, heights, the Mordell-Weil theorem, and descent. Siegel's theorem and integral points. Néron models and the Tate curve. Galois representations, complex multiplication, modular forms and modularity, and the Birch and Swinnerton-Dyer conjecture.

nodes.title: Étale Cohomology
nodes.description: Étale, unramified, and smooth morphisms and Henselian local rings. Finite étale covers, Galois categories, the étale fundamental group, and the Riemann existence theorem. The étale site and its sheaves. Étale and Čech cohomology, the cohomology of a point, and Hilbert 90. The Kummer and Artin-Schreier sequences. The cohomology of curves and the Brauer group of a function field. Finiteness theorems, the Brauer group of a scheme, the base change theorems, Poincaré duality, ℓ-adic cohomology, and the Weil conjectures coming soon.

nodes.title: Functional Analysis
nodes.description: Banach spaces, the Baire category theorem and its consequences, and the Hahn-Banach theorem. Dual spaces, weak topologies, Fréchet spaces, and the Krein-Milman theorem. Lᵖ spaces, their duals, and interpolation. Distributions. Sobolev spaces, Sobolev embeddings, and compactness. Hilbert spaces and compact and Hilbert-Schmidt operators. Banach algebras, the continuous and Borel functional calculus, and the spectral theorem for bounded self-adjoint operators. Unbounded self-adjoint operators and their spectral theorem, Stone's theorem, and C₀-semigroups with the Hille-Yosida theorem.

nodes.title: Group and Galois Cohomology
nodes.description: Profinite groups and the absolute Galois group. Group cohomology through derived functors and cocycles, and its low-degree interpretations. Profinite cohomology and the Lyndon-Hochschild-Serre spectral sequence. Tate cohomology and cup products. Cohomological dimension. Pro-p groups and the Golod-Shafarevich inequality. The Brauer group. Local fields, local Tate duality, and local reciprocity. Adèles and idèles. Global fields: the Poitou-Tate sequence, reciprocity, and Selmer and Shafarevich-Tate groups. Galois descent and non-abelian cohomology.

nodes.title: Algebraic Groups and Representations
nodes.description: Linear algebraic groups as varieties and as functors. Group actions, representations, and comodules. Lie algebras, the adjoint representation, and Cartier's theorem. Quotients G/H and exact sequences. The Jordan decomposition, tori, and unipotent groups. Solvable groups, the Lie-Kolchin theorem, Borel subgroups, and flag varieties. Roots, Weyl groups, root data, and the classification of reductive groups. Highest weight theory and complete reducibility. The Weyl character formula. Line bundles on G/B and the Borel-Weil-Bott theorem. Positive characteristic: Weyl modules, Steinberg's tensor product theorem, and Lusztig's conjecture.

nodes.title: Harmonic Analysis
nodes.description: The Fourier transform, Fourier series, and pointwise convergence. Kakeya sets and the Fourier transform. Tempered distributions, singular integrals and Calderón-Zygmund theory, Sobolev spaces, and applications to PDE. Dual groups of locally compact abelian groups, Bochner's theorem, Fourier inversion, the Plancherel theorem, and Pontryagin duality. Homogeneous distributions and oscillatory integrals coming soon.

nodes.title: Higher Category Theory
nodes.description: Simplicial sets, nerves, geometric realization, and Kan complexes. Model categories and Quillen functors. Homotopy limits and colimits. Simplicial, monoidal, and pointed model categories and Bousfield localization. Simplicial homotopy theory: the Dold-Kan correspondence and Postnikov towers. Quasi-categories, the Joyal model structure, ∞-limits and colimits, and the ∞-Yoneda lemma. Kan extensions and localization in ∞-categories, stable ∞-categories, ∞-operads, and ∞-toposes coming soon.

nodes.title: Hodge Theory
nodes.description: Complex manifolds, holomorphic bundles, and divisors. Sheaf and Dolbeault cohomology and GAGA. Kähler metrics and the Kähler identities. The Hodge decomposition and the Lefschetz (1,1)-theorem. Hodge structures, polarizations, and period domains. Hard Lefschetz, Lefschetz pencils, and the Picard-Lefschetz formula. Variations of Hodge structure and period maps. Mumford-Tate groups, Hodge classes and Hodge loci, and K3 surfaces. Mixed Hodge structures on smooth and singular varieties. Algebraic cycles, the Hodge conjecture, Abel-Jacobi maps, and Mumford's theorem on zero-cycles coming soon.

nodes.title: Homological Algebra
nodes.description: Abelian categories and the localization of categories. Complexes, projective and injective resolutions, Ext and Tor, δ-functors, and double complexes. Triangulated categories, the derived category, and total derived functors. Group cohomology, homological dimension, and applications to commutative algebra. Unbounded derived categories and t-structures. Spectral sequences of filtered and double complexes, the Grothendieck spectral sequence, and hypercohomology. Spectral sequences from the derived category coming soon.

nodes.title: Intersection Theory
nodes.description: Algebraic cycles and rational equivalence. Cartier divisors and the first Chern class. Segre classes and Chern classes. Deformation to the normal cone and the Gysin map. The intersection product, the Chow ring, excess intersection, and Bézout's theorem. Algebraic equivalence, the cycle class map, homological and numerical equivalence, and correspondences. Grothendieck-Riemann-Roch. Schubert calculus, degeneracy loci, and classical enumerative problems.

nodes.title: Vector Bundles and K-Theory
nodes.description: Vector bundles and classifying spaces. K⁰(X), Bott periodicity, and K-theory as a generalized cohomology theory. Characteristic classes and the Chern character. λ-rings, Adams operations, and the Hopf invariant one problem. Real K-theory. Eight-fold periodicity, the Thom isomorphism and pushforward, Fredholm operators and the index, and equivariant K-theory coming soon.

nodes.title: Local Langlands for GL₂(F)
nodes.description: Smooth representations of locally profinite groups and Hecke algebras. The principal series of GL₂(F) and Jacquet modules. Cuspidal representations, compact induction, and fundamental strata. Admissible pairs and the tame parametrization. Functional equations for GL₁ and GL₂, local constants, and the converse theorem. Weil groups, Deligne representations, and the tame Langlands correspondence. Whittaker and Kirillov models and the Weil representation. Dyadic fields, ordinary representations, and tame lifting. The dyadic correspondence and the Jacquet-Langlands correspondence coming soon.

nodes.title: Lie Groups
nodes.description: Matrix Lie groups, the classical groups, and the exponential map. Lie groups, their Lie algebras, and the adjoint representations. The closed subgroup theorem and the Lie correspondence. Homogeneous spaces and covering groups. Solvable, nilpotent, and semisimple Lie algebras, Weyl's theorem, and the Levi decomposition. Cartan subalgebras, root systems, and the classification by Dynkin diagrams. Universal enveloping algebras and Ado's theorem. Compact groups, Haar measure, and the Peter-Weyl theorem. Maximal tori and the Weyl integration formula. Highest weights, the Weyl character formula, and Borel-Weil. Real forms, the Cartan and Iwasawa decompositions, and symmetric spaces.

nodes.title: Linear Algebra
nodes.description: Linear systems, elimination, and the LU factorization. Vector spaces over R and C and the four fundamental subspaces. Determinants as signed volume and orientation. Eigenvalues, diagonalization, the minimal polynomial, and Cayley-Hamilton. Inner products, orthogonality, least squares, and the pseudoinverse. The spectral theorem. Quadratic forms, Sylvester's law of inertia, and positive definiteness. Complexification and complex structures. Hermitian and symplectic forms. The singular value decomposition. Jordan forms and matrix functions. Conditioning, perturbation and computation of eigenvalues, and Perron-Frobenius.

nodes.title: Linear Elliptic and Parabolic PDE
nodes.description: Weak formulations and the Lax-Milgram theorem. The Sobolev setup for boundary-value problems. Existence by the direct method and the Fredholm alternative. Schauder estimates and classical solutions. Lᵖ regularity through Calderón-Zygmund theory. The spectrum of the Dirichlet Laplacian and Weyl's law. Maximum principles, Green's functions, the heat equation, and semigroups coming soon.

nodes.title: Local Field Theory
nodes.description: p-adic numbers, discrete valuation rings, completions, and local fields. Hensel's lemma and Newton polygons. Extensions of local fields: unramified, tame, and wild ramification, ramification groups, the different and discriminant, and the Hilbert symbol. Witt vectors. The local-global correspondence and the Kronecker-Weber theorem. The Hasse principle for conics. Places of global fields, the product formula, and the Arakelov compactification. The Hasse-Arf theorem. Quadratic forms over local fields and the Hasse-Minkowski theorem coming soon.

nodes.title: Logic
nodes.description: First-order languages, structures, truth, and logical implication. Propositional logic. Deductions, soundness, completeness, and compactness. Turing machines, recursive functions, and their equivalence. Gödel's incompleteness theorems. Algebraic logic coming soon.

nodes.title: Elementary Analysis II
nodes.description: Metric spaces: open and closed sets, continuity, subspaces, and products. Completeness, Cauchy sequences, the complete spaces of analysis, and the completion. The contraction principle, compactness, uniform convergence, the space C(K) with the Stone-Weierstrass and Arzelà-Ascoli theorems, and Baire category coming soon.

nodes.title: Microlocal Analysis
nodes.description: Symbol classes, oscillatory integrals, and stationary phase. Pseudodifferential operators and the symbolic calculus. Elliptic operators, parametrices, and elliptic regularity. Pseudodifferential operators and elliptic theory on closed manifolds. Wavefront sets, propagation of singularities, Fourier integral operators, and the Atiyah-Singer index theorem coming soon.

nodes.title: Moduli, Deformation Theory, and Stacks
nodes.description: Moduli problems as functors, fine and coarse moduli spaces, and representability. The Hilbert and Quot schemes. Geometric invariant theory. First-order deformations, obstructions, and Schlessinger's criteria. Grothendieck topologies, faithfully flat descent, torsors, and the Picard scheme. Fibered categories, stacks, and quotient stacks. Algebraic spaces, Deligne-Mumford and Artin stacks, and Artin's representability criteria. Gerbes, the Brauer group, and twisted sheaves. The moduli of stable curves.

nodes.title: Nonlinear Wave and Dispersive PDE
nodes.description: First-order linear and quasilinear equations. The wave equation: d'Alembert's formula, Duhamel's principle, and higher dimensions. Weak solutions, energy estimates, and Sobolev spaces. Littlewood-Paley theory. Local existence and uniqueness for nonlinear wave equations. The Klainerman-Sobolev inequality, the null condition, and global existence. Low-regularity well-posedness coming soon.

nodes.title: Ordinary Differential Equations (ODE)
nodes.description: First-order scalar equations. Second-order linear equations. Linear systems and the matrix exponential. The Picard-Lindelöf theorem, maximal solutions, continuous dependence, and the flow. Phase space and stability, Lyapunov's direct method, and limit cycles. Boundary-value problems, Sturm-Liouville theory, and Green's functions. Series solutions and the Legendre and Bessel functions.

nodes.title: Preliminaries
nodes.description: series-wide foundation: logic, naive set theory, proof techniques, relations and orders, functions, cardinality, elementary number theory, first exposure to categories.

nodes.title: Probability
nodes.description: Probability spaces, the construction of probability measures, and the Borel-Cantelli lemmas. Random variables, independence, product measures, and Kolmogorov's zero-one law. Expectation, inequalities, and generating functions. Sums of independent random variables and random series. The weak and strong laws of large numbers. Weak convergence and characteristic functions. The central limit theorem, the Lindeberg-Feller theorem, and the Erdős-Kac theorem. The law of the iterated logarithm. Conditional expectation. Discrete-time martingales: optional stopping and convergence.

nodes.title: Real Analysis
nodes.description: σ-algebras, outer measure, the Carathéodory construction, and Lebesgue-Stieltjes measures. Measurable functions, the Lebesgue integral, the convergence theorems, and modes of convergence. Product measures, Fubini-Tonelli, and Lebesgue measure on Rⁿ. Signed measures, the Radon-Nikodym theorem, complex measures, the Lebesgue differentiation theorem, and functions of bounded variation. Radon measures and the Riesz-Markov theorem. Hausdorff dimension, Besicovitch sets, and the Kakeya conjecture. Haar measure.

nodes.title: Riemannian Geometry
nodes.description: Riemannian and pseudo-Riemannian metrics and isometries. The Levi-Civita connection and parallel transport. Geodesics and the exponential map. The curvature tensor, sectional, Ricci, and scalar curvature, and space forms. Jacobi fields and conjugate points. Completeness, Hopf-Rinow, and the comparison theorems of Bonnet-Myers, Cartan-Hadamard, and Rauch. Submanifold geometry and Riemannian submersions. Gauss-Bonnet, Synge's theorem, and the sphere theorem. Homogeneous and symmetric spaces and holonomy. Connections on vector bundles and Chern-Weil theory. The Hodge-de Rham theorem and the Bochner technique.

nodes.title: Shimura Varieties
nodes.description: The modular curve as an arithmetic quotient. Hermitian symmetric domains, Hodge structures and the Deligne torus, Shimura data and Shimura varieties, Baily-Borel, special points and canonical models, Siegel and PEL moduli, automorphic vector bundles, and the cohomology of Shimura varieties coming soon.

nodes.title: Mathematical Statistics
nodes.description: Statistical models, loss and risk, admissibility, and the Bayes and minimax principles. Sufficiency, ancillarity, completeness, and exponential families. Unbiased estimation, Fisher information and the Cramér-Rao bound, and UMVU estimation. Maximum likelihood, Bayesian estimation, hypothesis testing, confidence sets, large-sample theory, the Gaussian linear model, and nonparametric methods and the bootstrap coming soon.

nodes.title: Topology
nodes.description: Topological spaces, continuity, Hausdorff spaces, and countability axioms. Subspace, product, and quotient topologies, metric spaces, and uniform spaces. Connectedness, compactness, nets and filters, and function spaces. Separation axioms, Urysohn's lemma, metrization, and the Tietze extension theorem. Paracompactness, partitions of unity, and the Stone-Čech compactification. The fundamental group, covering spaces and their classification, and Brouwer's fixed point theorem. Topological groups and locally compact groups.

nodes.title: Toric Geometry
nodes.description: Algebraic tori, characters, and lattices. Affine toric varieties and cones, projective toric varieties and polytopes, fans, the orbit-cone correspondence, divisors and the class group, the Cox construction, sheaf cohomology and toric Riemann-Roch, toric resolution of singularities, and reflexive polytopes and mirror symmetry coming soon.

nodes.title: Unstable Motivic Homotopy Theory
nodes.description: Serre's problem, Quillen-Suslin, and the Bass-Quillen conjecture. A¹-invariant presheaves. Simplicial presheaves, the Nisnevich topology, the A¹-homotopy category, motivic spheres and classifying spaces, representability of algebraic K-theory, purity, affine representability, realizations, Milnor-Witt K-theory, strongly A¹-invariant sheaves, the A¹-degree, Euler classes, and rank-two bundles on affine threefolds coming soon.

clusters.label: Langlands programme
clusters.description: Toward the local Langlands correspondence for GL₂, representation theory and class field theory up through smooth representations and the GL₂ case.

clusters.label: Arithmetic geometry
clusters.description: The arithmetic of varieties, elliptic curves, abelian varieties, and Shimura varieties over number fields, resting on algebraic and arithmetic foundations.

clusters.label: Hodge theory & cycles
clusters.description: Complex and Kähler geometry toward Hodge theory, algebraic cycles, and the (integral) Hodge conjecture.

clusters.label: K-theory
clusters.description: The three flavours of K-theory, topological, algebraic, and operator (C*), and their shared homotopical/homological foundations.

clusters.label: Motivic homotopy
clusters.description: From simplicial sets and model categories through algebraic geometry and algebraic K-theory to A1-homotopy theory and the classification of algebraic vector bundles.

clusters.label: Analysis → PDE
clusters.description: The analysis ladder, from elementary analysis through measure theory and functional analysis to ODE and PDE.
